caption: The drawing features a single, high-waisted, long-sleeved women's dress in a deep teal green color, displayed on a blank mannequin torso with no head or arms. The dress has a wide, slightly gathered neckline, large puffed sleeves gathered at the shoulder and cuffed at the wrist, and a fitted waistband directly below the bust. The skirt is long and full, reaching the ground, and is decorated with two horizontal strips near the hem and another at about knee height, adding texture and visual interest. To the upper right of the main colored illustration, there is a smaller, monochrome pencil sketch of the same dress from the back, showing similar details, including the puffed sleeves, waistband, and banded embellishments on the skirt. The entire drawing is set on an off-white or parchment-colored background.
title: Dress
